item.description: Run steps in listed order. Step 2 saves the tenant JWT into bearerToken (required for 3+). For RAG, call 7.5 Validate Rag Config before 8 Publish. Flow validation 10.1c needs 10.1b graph draft validated first; the API requires a published execution limit policy on the tenant (created automatically when the tenant is created on a current server). Steps 11 then 12 then 11.1: template node, node prompt (IntentClassifier, sets node_prompt_id), custom node. Step 13 (user prompt) runs before 26 for MCP. Step 11 test saves node_id.
